issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Rideable.messageOnRide: the problem statement (UML and textual description) and the template Main expect a no-argument method messageOnRide(): String that returns strings like "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]". The solution repository instead declares Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implements this parameterized signature in Pig and Seal (e.g., Pig.messageOnRide(String equipment)). This disagreement about the method parameter list is a genuine contradiction across artifacts and will confuse students which signature to implement and which tests/calls are correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the messageOnRide signature across all artifacts. Preferred fix (match problem/template): change the Rideable interface in the solution to declare String messageOnRide() (no parameters), and update Pig and Seal to implement the no-arg version returning "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" (use getClass().getSimpleName() or hardcode the type). Alternatively, if an equipment parameter is intended, update the problem statement, UML, template Main (calls and examples) and tests to require messageOnRide(String equipment) and document expected output including the equipment. Ensure all three places (problem statement/UML, template code, and solution/tests) use the exact same method signature.
